prompt:
You watch a short video made ONLY of these clips, played back to back with NO narration between them.
Each clip is a person's own words from a show; the shows were not in one conversation. The first clip (label "hook")
opens the video. The hook is shown for context only: it is NOT rated here (its own job was judged on its own).

CLIP label="hook" (on screen: Simply Bitcoin): "AI can copy software, undercut margins, replace employees, help foreign actors to overthrow your CEO. But... They can't print more Bitcoin."
CLIP label="clip_01" (on screen: Robert Breedlove): "So over time, I came to the conclusion that real estate will most likely replace or will be replaced. So real estate will most likely... be replaced by Bitcoin in its function as a savings account."
CLIP label="clip_02" (on screen: Stephan Livera): "A Bitcoin mine does not get better at mining Bitcoin the longer it mines Bitcoin. The only way to get better at it is to become faster or to become larger."
CLIP label="clip_03" (on screen: Yahoo Finance): "I think, well, what we've seen in the market is on Thursday, Friday, there was actually a much bigger drop in traditional stock prices, especially tech stock. There's like 10, 20%, like Intel dropped 29%. Whereas Bitcoin only dropped like five, six percent."

1) Played back to back with no narration, is there a through-line a viewer can state? State it in ONE sentence, or
   "none" if there is none.
2) For each clip AFTER the hook, rate 1-5 how much it advances that through-line (5 = essential, 1 = off topic).
3) For each JOIN between two consecutive clips, the hook's own join included (does the hook set up the clip after
   it?): could a viewer follow the jump with no narration, i.e. is the next clip's subject or referent clear coming
   from the previous clip's ending? Answer true or false, and why in a few words.
Return ONLY this JSON object: {"through_line": "...", "clips": {"clip_01": 1, "clip_02": 1, "clip_03": 1}, "joins": {"hook -> clip_01": {"followable": true, "why": "..."}, "clip_01 -> clip_02": {"followable": true, "why": "..."}, "clip_02 -> clip_03": {"followable": true, "why": "..."}}}
text: {"through_line": "Bitcoin has unique economic properties—fixed supply, as a savings technology, competitive mining, and relative market resilience—that distinguish it from traditional assets and industries.", "clips": {"clip_01": 5, "clip_02": 3, "clip_03": 5}, "joins": {"hook -> clip_01": {"followable": true, "why": "Bitcoin scarcity leads to Bitcoin as savings account."}, "clip_01 -> clip_02": {"followable": true, "why": "Bitcoin remains the referent, though topic shifts to mining."}, "clip_02 -> clip_03": {"followable": false, "why": "Abrupt shift to market prices; no clear referent."}}}
